query:
SELECT 
  CONCAT('INSERT INTO clients (id, userId, name, gender, phone, email, consultationNotes, preferredConcept, status, tags, partnerId, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES ',
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      CONCAT('(',
        COALESCE(id, 'NULL'), ', ',
        COALESCE(userId, 'NULL'), ', ',
        CONCAT("'", REPLACE(COALESCE(name, ''), "'", "''"), "'"), ', ',
        CONCAT("'", COALESCE(gender, ''), "'"), ', ',
        IF(phone IS NULL, 'NULL', CONCAT("'", REPLACE(phone, "'", "''"), "'")), ', ',
        IF(email IS NULL, 'NULL', CONCAT("'", REPLACE(email, "'", "''"), "'")), ', ',
        IF(consultationNotes IS NULL, 'NULL', CONCAT("'", REPLACE(consultationNotes, "'", "''"), "'")), ', ',
        IF(preferredConcept IS NULL, 'NULL', CONCAT("'", REPLACE(preferredConcept, "'", "''"), "'")), ', ',
        CONCAT("'", COALESCE(status, ''), "'"), ', ',
        IF(tags IS NULL, 'NULL', CONCAT("'", REPLACE(tags, "'", "''"), "'")), ', ',
        COALESCE(partnerId, 'NULL'), ', ',
        CONCAT("'", createdAt, "'"), ', ',
        CONCAT("'", updatedAt, "'"),
      ')'
      )
      SEPARATOR ', '
    ),
  ';'
  ) AS sql_statement
FROM clients;
